verdict.rationale: An independent TechPowerUp review of the RTX 5070 Ti reports all four memory specs: 16 GB capacity, GDDR7 at 28 Gbps, a 256-bit bus and 896 GB/s bandwidth. A Hacker News comment corroborates the 28 Gbps memory speed. None of the first-party NVIDIA pages in the pack (DLSS, 5070 family marketing, CUDA toolkit) publish any memory specs, so full publication for this exact part rests on third-party sources. Missing for 10: a first-party NVIDIA spec sheet listing capacity, memory type, bus width and bandwidth for the 5070 Ti; vendor confirmation of the reviewer's figures.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth

citations.quote: 16 GB vs 12 GB, a 256-bit bus vs 192-bit, and 28 Gbps GDDR7, giving 896 GB/s, about 77% more bandwidth
